$comment: TrustLens formal negative-indicator & suppression library (WP3, closes G-07). Authoritative home for negative (SUPPRESSIVE) indicators, replacing the NEGATIVE half of indicator-registry-v0.json. Consumed by validate_rules.py (resolution + checks) and rule_runner.py (deterministic, explainable suppression). Numeric score-reduction magnitudes are NOT defined here - they are deferred to DET-001 (CONF-001); effects here are ordinal/categorical.
provenance: Authored from the inverse of verified official guidance (SRC-004/006/021 et al.) and the ADR-0015 evidence hierarchy. Evidence-class/strength/effect assignments are HEURISTIC programme judgements (G-07).

categories.EDUCATIONAL_SAFETY: Scam-awareness / safety guidance: warns the user, does not instruct them.
categories.CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_SAFETY: Official 'we will never ask for X' support language.
categories.LEGIT_SERVICE_COMMS: Ordinary bank/service communication: notifications, official-channel redirects, no credential request.
categories.LEGIT_PAYMENT_DIRECTION: A clearly legitimate outbound payment direction (paying a known merchant).
categories.IT_SUPPORT: A legitimate, user-expected IT-support context with no banking/payment fraud signals.
categories.USER_INITIATED: The user themselves initiated the action (only trustworthy if the context model can observe it).
categories.ALLOWLIST_DOMAIN: A verified/allowlisted domain context. Weak by design; never cancels a hard-risk pattern.
categories.REPORTED_SCAM: The user is reporting/quoting scam wording, not receiving a live instruction.
categories.NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL: A directional negation that neutralises a specific positive indicator ('do NOT share your OTP').
categories.BENIGN_CONTEXT: Weak benign context (low amount, no urgency). Adds evidence; never cancels alone.

suppression_effects.SUPPRESS_RULE: Cancels the whole matched rule (unless a hard-risk override is active).
suppression_effects.SUPPRESS_INDICATOR: Neutralises specific positive indicator(s) before the rule is evaluated (directional). Not blocked by overrides.
suppression_effects.CAP_SEVERITY: Caps the fired rule's severity to an ordinal ceiling; does not cancel.
suppression_effects.CONTEXT_ONLY: Records benign context; never changes the finding. (No numeric score-reduction here — REDUCE magnitudes are deferred to DET-001, CONF-001.)

resolution_order: 1. SUPPRESS_INDICATOR (directional negation) removes its target positives from the signal set; the rule's require is re-evaluated.
2. If the rule still matches, active hard-risk OVERRIDES are computed on the reduced set.
3. If any applicable override is active, it BLOCKS all SUPPRESS_RULE and CAP_SEVERITY effects from its blocked categories; the rule fires and the block is recorded as an explanation.
4. Otherwise, an active SUPPRESS_RULE cancels the rule; active CAP_SEVERITY caps its severity ordinally.
5. CONTEXT_ONLY indicators are recorded as benign evidence and never change the finding.

overrides.name: Credential/QR+PIN demanded to RECEIVE money
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: NPCI/CERT-In: you never need a PIN or OTP to receive money.

overrides.name: Explicit request to disclose an OTP
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: RBI: institutions never ask for your OTP. A live disclosure request is hard-risk.

overrides.name: Payment demanded under arrest/legal/block threat
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: NITI Aayog digital-arrest: coercive payment demands are hard-risk.

overrides.name: Wallet connect to an unknown verification site
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: I4C CyberDost Trust Wallet drain chain.

overrides.name: Out-of-context Accessibility permission after app/link delivery
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.

overrides.name: Screen-share/remote-control requested in a banking context
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: HDFC/NPCI: banks never ask you to install AnyDesk/TeamViewer. Blocks IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT.
